chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya from 'Isa ibn al-Qasim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who catches up with the funeral prayer with one Takbir; he said, 'He completes what remains.'
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they join the funeral prayer late and miss most of it?
ai.summary: This ruling from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the principle of *tamam al-salah* (completing the prayer) for latecomers in funeral prayers, ensuring the validity of their individual obligation. It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on the completeness of ritual acts even when joined partially, distinguishing it from congregational prayers where following the Imam is paramount.
